final_delta: Tool/skill/README native-terminal-only deadline qualification; control logic unchanged; archive comparison retained separately.

acceptance.title: Native parent public lifecycle and policies
acceptance.outcome: Four public spawn calls confirm independent policies; actual parent later send/run/read/ack/resume. No controller substitution for parent lifecycle.

acceptance.title: Four owner/archive combinations
acceptance.outcome: Both automatic-close lanes retire after native completed results while parent is live, without ack. Resumed with explicit 6000ms and no new input, they stay open until parent exit: both nonpersistent lanes disconnect, both persistent remain. Six-second mechanism tested; exact 60000 default and active owner loss remain controlled-test coverage.

acceptance.title: Idle stage and idle wake
acceptance.outcome: Stage returns queued_for_next_turn and no-record status; child checkpoint contains one user/no assistant before explicit run. Later run consumes staged marker. Wake send returns injected; one native query result appears without explicit start/run for that message.

acceptance.title: Persistence, replacement collector and independent archive
acceptance.outcome: Distinct group-authorized collector receives wake result after actual parent quit. Persistent auto-close lane remains before any new run and retires after its next native terminal; zero-auto lane remains until explicit close.

acceptance.title: Cancellation, repeated reads and ordered ack
acceptance.outcome: Caller wait cancellation after successful wait-frame write returns canceled; another caller reads the result. Next wake proceeds with prior result unacked; oldest stays /2, ack advances to /3; repeated reads match, then ack leaves no record. This installed cancellation is public Caller API, not native MCP notification cancellation; latter retains controlled tests.

acceptance.title: Normal close and component cleanup
acceptance.outcome: Normal close returns success and all twelve previously bound worker/native/our-MCP PIDs absent at later checkpoint. Parent native exits0 and reaped; parent three identified processes absent. No independent before-close-result death ordering, native lane exit status, arbitrary-descendant or quit-hook cause claim.

acceptance.title: Same-install interactive regression
acceptance.outcome: Native parent loads actual generic skill/public tool; mixed -g and --group are present in actual roster. Lane completion pointer arrives as ordinary native user message after parent final reply, then parent public wait/status/ack consumes it. Ordinary zero-prompt invocation has no direct Go MCP at checkpoint, native exit0/reaped and both identified PIDs absent; separate ordinary manifest.

accounting.scope: Counts from retained operator inputs and exact correlated native turns, not native num_turns metadata.

limits: First observer enumerated only main-thread children and missed lane PIDs. Corrected supplemental observer unions direct task children; no process credit for earlier zero arrays. Initial auto-retirement lacks exact PID binding; later resumed groups are bound.
Collector initially lacked private group and correctly saw no lanes. A distinct authorized collector then used the actual group reported by native parent list; never the parent identity.
Parent stopped after expected -32001 pre-run status. Preserved no-run checkpoint; subsequent explicit run was a separate prompt, without repeating send/status or altering configuration.
Original projection omitted setup marker, native timestamps and empty ack shape; separately named later projections add those requested facts. Original source/snapshots remain unchanged.
Cancellation client and collector are test controls using the actual pinned public SDK. No installed native MCP cancellation-notification claim.
No new claim for active owner-death, every scheduling race, unavailable ack/oversize/native-error grace, or default-clock timing beyond separately reviewed controlled tests.
